title: LoRa Scanner
summary: LoRa spectrum + Meshtastic & LoRaWAN packet decoder + GPS coverage map
description: LoRa Scanner shows and decodes what is on the air in the US 902-928 MHz band using the Cap LoRa-1262. Spectrum with max-hold and a waterfall show activity across the band. The Meshtastic Finder listens on each preset's default frequency and decodes the public default channel: text messages, node names, telemetry, positions and traceroutes (private channels stay encrypted). The LoRaWAN page hops the US915 channels of any sub-band (or the gateway downlink channels) and decodes frame headers: device address, network (The Things Network, Helium...), frame counter, port, and join requests with the device's EUI. Every packet is listed with full details and a hex dump, logged to ~/LoRaScan/packets.csv, and - with the Cap's GPS - plotted on a coverage map you can export as a Google Earth KML file. Receive only: it never transmits. Requires the Cap LoRa-1262.
